holiday_note: Only 2 public holidays fall within this dataset's 2022-02-11 to 2022-04-06 window (1 March 2022 (Maha Shivaratri), 18 March 2022 (Holi)), landing on Tuesdays and Fridays only. Holiday effect (23.7% vs 22.9% breach rate) is directional, not statistically robust given the small sample (1999 holiday-flagged rows).
